title: Ops Slate: Quick Network Diagnostics & Canary Risk Surface for Private Console
creator: Maya Kapoor
description:
Goal: Design a compact, actionable 'Ops Slate' panel for the Private/VPC Console that surfaces fast network diagnostics, per-tenant egress cost previews, and a lightweight canary risk overlay for cluster upgrades. This panel should be discoverable from tenant and cluster detail pages and usable by SREs and tenant-ops engineers who need to triage connectivity and make go/no-go upgrade decisions quickly.

Scope and constraints:
- Focus on Private/VPC deployment flows (on-prem and VPC clusters).
- Read-only UI surface: no direct network changes (links to runbooks and operations playbooks).
- Integrates with existing telemetry (traces, mock packet replay, path snapshots) but must degrade gracefully when data is missing.
- Must show cost delta estimates for planned upgrade/canary (egress changes due to reroutes).
- Accessibility and compactness: prioritize a single-row compact tile for dashboard and expanded panel for investigation.

Primary user stories:
1) As a tenant ops engineer, I want a quick snapshot of recent connectivity regressions (latency spikes, packet loss) so I can decide whether to pause a rollout.
2) As an SRE on call, I want to simulate a short packet-path replay and see likely affected tenants so I can coordinate mitigations.
3) As a release owner, I want an at-a-glance canary risk score that combines traffic affected, past incidents, and cost exposure to make rollout decisions.

Design principles:
- Surface signal, not noise: show prioritized indicators (red/yellow/green) with one-click drill-in.
- Combine operational telemetry and cost economics in the same view to make tradeoffs explicit.
- Provide clear next actionable steps (jump to runbook, open incident, pause rollout).

Prototype notes:
- Compact tile for cluster list (small sparkline for latency, mini-risk badge, cost delta icon).
- Expanded Ops Slate modal with three tabs: Diagnostics, Canary Risk, Cost Impact.
- Diagnostics: recent anomalies, last synthetic path replay, quick-links to packet traces and topology map.
- Canary Risk: composite score, contributors (traffic % impacted, historical regression rate, region health), suggested mitigations.
- Cost Impact: estimated egress delta, preview of monthly cost shift, quick calc for temporary throttles.

Acceptance criteria:
- Tile and expanded panel implemented in Figma and clickable prototype flows for the three primary user stories.
- Usability test with 3 SREs and 3 tenant operators, with >=80% success rate on go/no-go decision task.
- Design tokens and spacing consistent with Console 2026 patterns.
- Handoff-ready assets: component specs, accessibility annotations, and copy guidelines.

Trade-offs and open questions:
- How much logic should live client-side vs server-side for the composite canary risk score? (defer to ENG for compute location).
- Depth of replay: full packet-level replay may be slow; we propose a sampled snapshot for initial surface and link to detailed trace UI.
- Egress cost estimate accuracy: provide a confidence band rather than exact numbers to set expectations.

Next milestones:
- 2026-03-08: incorporate ENG feedback on data availability and API shape.
- 2026-03-15: usability testing and iterate prototype.
- 2026-03-22: final design handoff for implementation in console-2026.03 release.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype (tile + expanded panel) with clickable flows for Diagnostics, Canary Risk, and Cost Impact
3 SREs and 3 tenant operators complete a go/no-go decision task with >=80% success
Component specs, spacing, and accessibility notes documented for handoff
Clear API data contract doc linked for ENG (fields and fallbacks)
